analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, delivering record H1 revenue of ₹1,235 crore and PAT of ₹125 crore, up 96% year-on-year. Management noted mixed raw material price trends, with sulphur and phosphoric acid prices elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate stayed stable. The company is leveraging expanded capacities in NPK/DAP and sulphuric acid alongside strategic sourcing agreements, including a green ammonia agreement with SECI. Favourable policy support via increased Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) rates for Rabi 2026-27 is expected to support farm economics and demand for phosphatic fertilizers. In its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, Krishana Phoschem reported revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, reflecting a 35% year-on-year growth, and EBITDA of ₹89 crore, up 36% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem targets achieving 30%–35% revenue growth over the previous year.
guidance.quote: So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain a quarterly revenue run-rate of over ₹500 crore for the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining momentum through the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon recovery, higher crop MSPs, and NBS support are expected to support fertilizer demand for the rest of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth backed by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive due to comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is strengthening long-term prospects for the sector.
demand_outlook.quote: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating further capacity expansion opportunities that are yet to be finalized or board approved.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are progressively contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

margins_costs.claim: During the period, sulphur and phosphoric acid prices remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost trends remained mixed during the period, with sulphur and phosphoric acid prices elevated, while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate prices remained broadly stable.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA increased by 56% year-on-year to ₹216 crore, with PAT reaching an all-time high of ₹125 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 56% year-on-year to ₹216 crore, while profit after tax reached an all-time high of ₹125 crore, growing 96% year-on-year, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency and resilient business fundamentals.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached ₹ 89 crore, reflecting 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stand at approximately 7%–8% for trading operations and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has passed on around 25%–30% of raw material cost increases through higher subsidies and MRP revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs contributed to higher Q1 FY27 EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore driven by capacity utilization and execution across the integrated value chain.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across our integrated value chain.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains peak capacity utilization in SSP and headroom to scale manufactured NPK operations.
orders_capacity.quote: With peak capacity utilisation in SSP and significant headroom to scale our manufactured NPK business, we are well-positioned to enhance production volumes, improve integration benefits and strengthen our market presence.

orders_capacity.claim: Krishana Phoschem produced 89,747 metric tonnes of fertilizers during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in Q1 FY27 was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 FY27 sales volumes were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP, 36,300 MT for SSP, and 21,000 MT for trading.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company relies on an integrated cost structure to support operating margins and an efficient working capital cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: • Strong operating margins & efficient working capital cycle

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing share face value from ₹ 10 to ₹ 2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Depreciation rose to ₹13 crore and finance costs increased to ₹20 crore following the commissioning of new capacity.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of the company's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty across global commodity markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty in global commodity markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply constraints led to a 28% YoY decline in overall industry fertilizer production and a 7% drop in SSP production during April-May 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia around the Strait of Hormuz caused shipping delays and elevated freight and procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices surged from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged that its forward-looking expectations involve various risks and uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements related to Krishana Phoschem Limited (KRISHANA) are based on current expectations and projections that involve a number of risks and uncertainties.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore across the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The third-party green ammonia supply capacity under agreement with SECI will commence operations in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to build on operational momentum through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
